items.stem: Under the shared-responsibility model for an IaaS virtual machine, who is responsible for patching the guest operating system?

options.text: The customer, because the OS runs above the provider's responsibility boundary for IaaS
options.rationale: Correct: for IaaS the provider secures the hypervisor and below; the guest OS is the customer's.

options.text: The cloud provider, because they own all underlying hardware
options.rationale: The provider owns the hardware but not the guest OS in IaaS.

options.text: Neither party, because the OS patches itself automatically
options.rationale: Patching is not automatic by default and must be owned.
Auditors assess, they do not operate the control.

items.explanation: Correct: for IaaS the provider secures the hypervisor and below; the guest OS is the customer's.

items.stem: Which two findings represent an internet-exposed data store that should be prioritised? (Select TWO)

options.text: A storage bucket with a public-read access policy
options.rationale: Correct: public-read exposes data directly to the internet.

options.text: A database security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on the database port
options.rationale: Correct: an any-source rule on the DB port exposes it to the internet.

options.text: A database encrypted at rest with a managed key
options.rationale: Encryption at rest is a good control, not an exposure.

options.text: A VM in a private subnet with no public IP
options.rationale: No public IP and a private subnet is not internet-exposed.

items.explanation: Correct: public-read exposes data directly to the internet.; Correct: an any-source rule on the DB port exposes it to the internet.

items.stem: Why is a preventive guardrail generally stronger than a periodic scan for stopping public buckets?

options.text: It blocks the misconfiguration at creation time rather than reporting it after the fact
options.rationale: Correct: prevention stops the exposure window that a scan only detects later.

options.text: It removes the need to ever inventory resources
options.rationale: Inventory is still needed regardless of guardrails.

options.text: It encrypts the bucket contents automatically
options.rationale: A guardrail controls configuration, it does not perform encryption.

options.text: It guarantees compliance with every framework
options.rationale: One guardrail does not equal full compliance.

items.explanation: Correct: prevention stops the exposure window that a scan only detects later.
